description: Prefixing a shared matrix with existential and universal quantifiers gives exactly the numerical code obtained by iterating the corpus’s fixed existential and universal code constructors.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence_code (c : ℕ) (arities : List ℕ) {m n : ℕ}
  (φ : (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.lang c arities).BoundedFormula Empty (m + n)) :
  Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.sentenceCode
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.signature c arities)
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.sentence c arities φ) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.prefixCode m n
      (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.CodingFormalProofs.formulaCode
        (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.ExistentialUniversalSentences.signature c arities) Empty.elim φ)
